evidenceClusters.title: Target rationale
evidenceClusters.summary: Public CLDN18.2 and gastric/GEJ context supports a planning case with enough translational maturity to discuss validation logic.

evidenceClusters.title: Expression and off-tumor review
evidenceClusters.summary: The source set supports making tumor expression and normal-tissue/off-tumor review central to the plan, but it does not supply a numeric antigen-density gate.

evidenceClusters.title: Model and assay logic
evidenceClusters.summary: Assay categories can be organized into expression, potency, specificity, activation, cytokine, and phenotype/persistence checks without giving executable protocol parameters.

evidenceClusters.title: Clinical maturity context
evidenceClusters.summary: Clinical and registry records help explain why CLDN18.2 is a mature planning example, but they remain background only for bench validation and cannot prove safety or efficacy.

validationLogicMatrix.decisionPoint: Can activity be interpreted as target-dependent?
validationLogicMatrix.evidenceSummary: Expression and comparator evidence must line up before potency signals are interpreted.
validationLogicMatrix.planningLogic: Require target-expression confirmation plus antigen-negative or low-expression comparison before treating potency signals as target-linked.
validationLogicMatrix.gate: Hold if antigen-negative controls respond similarly or expression evidence is missing.

validationLogicMatrix.decisionPoint: Is off-tumor risk visible before escalation?
validationLogicMatrix.evidenceSummary: Tumor-expression rationale must be paired with normal-tissue and off-tumor review.
validationLogicMatrix.planningLogic: Pair tumor-expression rationale with normal-tissue/off-tumor review and explicit safety caveats.
validationLogicMatrix.gate: Hold if off-tumor review is unresolved or treated as proven safe from clinical context.

validationLogicMatrix.decisionPoint: Are model systems credible enough for first-pass planning?
validationLogicMatrix.evidenceSummary: Model classes should include target-positive, target-negative, and off-tumor-relevant comparison categories.
validationLogicMatrix.planningLogic: Use gastric/GEJ model classes with target-positive, target-negative, and off-tumor-relevant comparator categories.
validationLogicMatrix.gate: Hold if the model panel is a single positive context with no specificity comparator.

validationLogicMatrix.decisionPoint: Do controls make the result interpretable?
validationLogicMatrix.evidenceSummary: Controls must separate antigen-dependent signal from background or nonspecific activity.
validationLogicMatrix.planningLogic: Track target-positive, target-negative, non-targeted or mock-engineered, irrelevant-antigen, assay-background, and off-tumor comparison controls.
validationLogicMatrix.gate: Hold if control identity or acceptance logic is missing from expert review.

topRisks.title: Off-tumor uncertainty
topRisks.whyItMatters: CLDN18.2 planning is not credible unless normal-tissue and off-tumor concerns stay visible next to potency logic.
topRisks.nextAction: Assign expert review of normal-tissue expression and off-tumor comparator strategy.

topRisks.title: No numeric expression threshold
topRisks.whyItMatters: The evidence snapshot supports expression review, but not a universal antigen-density cutoff for go/no-go decisions.
topRisks.nextAction: Keep threshold setting outside the packet and require local assay owners to define it.

topRisks.title: Model and control panel still need expert selection
topRisks.whyItMatters: The packet names useful model/control categories, not validated cell lines, organoids, reagents, or acceptance windows.
topRisks.nextAction: Use the matrix as a planning checklist, then have domain experts choose concrete models and controls.

topRisks.title: Clinical context can be overread
topRisks.whyItMatters: Clinical and registry records explain maturity, but they cannot prove bench validation, safety, or efficacy.
topRisks.nextAction: Keep clinical sources as background and require assay-specific evidence for validation decisions.

decisionGates.label: Go
decisionGates.summary: Proceed to deeper validation planning only when expression evidence, specificity logic, controls, model context, and off-tumor review are coherent together.

decisionGates.label: Hold
decisionGates.summary: Pause when the evidence is promising but missing expression thresholds, control definitions, model specificity, or normal-tissue review.

decisionGates.label: No-go
decisionGates.summary: Stop if activity appears nonspecific, clinical context is being treated as proof, or the next request requires patient advice, protocol parameters, or safety clearance.

sections.title: Target rationale
sections.summary: Why CLDN18.2 in gastric/GEJ cancer is a useful target-validation planning case.

recommendations.text: Use CLDN18.2 in gastric/GEJ cancer as the worked planning case because public evidence supports target rationale, translational maturity context, and a visible off-tumor safety caveat.
caveats: Planning-case selection is not a claim of clinical superiority.
Clinical and trial records are context-only.

recommendations.text: Keep clinical maturity, target-expression rationale, and off-tumor review separate so the packet does not imply that one kind of evidence proves the others.
caveats: Clinical and registry records are background only for validation planning.

sections.title: Expression/off-tumor screen
sections.summary: Evidence checks that should precede any potency interpretation.

recommendations.text: Separate tumor-expression confirmation from normal-tissue/off-tumor risk review before interpreting any engineered-cell activity.
caveats: This planning packet does not set quantitative expression thresholds.

recommendations.text: Track antigen-positive, antigen-low or borderline, and antigen-negative evidence categories so response patterns can be interpreted as target-dependent rather than nonspecific.

sections.title: Model-system suggestions
sections.summary: Model classes to discuss in a translational validation meeting.

recommendations.text: Prioritize gastric/GEJ tumor model classes with documented CLDN18.2 signal, an antigen-negative comparator, and an off-tumor-relevant comparator where feasible.
caveats: Exact cell lines, organoids, and acceptance criteria require local expert selection.

recommendations.text: Use model diversity as a planning requirement: two-dimensional tumor models can support initial signal checks, while spheroid or organoid-like systems should be labeled as follow-up complexity rather than required proof.

sections.title: Assay modules
sections.summary: Non-executable assay families for the first-pass validation plan.

recommendations.text: Plan modular evidence families: target-expression verification, antigen-dependent killing or potency, immune-cell activation, cytokine release, specificity/off-tumor comparison, and phenotype or persistence review.
caveats: This is a module map, not a protocol or SOP.

recommendations.text: Do not treat a single positive killing readout as sufficient; require concordance across expression, specificity, activation, and safety-oriented checks before escalation.

sections.title: Controls
sections.summary: Control categories that keep the planning packet interpretable.

recommendations.text: Include control categories for antigen-positive target context, antigen-negative context, non-targeted or mock-engineered cell context, irrelevant-antigen context, assay background, and off-tumor-relevant comparison.
caveats: Control identities and lab acceptance windows require local expert selection.

recommendations.text: Mark clinical and registry records as target-context background only; they cannot serve as assay controls or validation proof.

sections.title: Readouts
sections.summary: Qualitative readout categories for expert review.

recommendations.text: Summarize readouts as categories: target expression, tumor-cell effect, antigen-dependent activation, cytokine signal, specificity against antigen-negative context, off-tumor comparator stress, and reproducibility across model classes.
caveats: No numeric thresholds are claimed by this planning packet.

recommendations.text: Flag discordant readouts as review items rather than forcing a pass/fail answer from incomplete evidence.

sections.title: Safety gaps
sections.summary: Known safety boundaries and missing evidence labels.

recommendations.text: Foreground CLDN18.2 on-target/off-tumor uncertainty and normal-tissue expression review as central to the validation plan.
caveats: The packet does not conclude that CLDN18.2 targeting is safe or unsafe.

recommendations.text: Use clinical and registry records only to explain translational maturity; do not use them as safety proof, efficacy proof, or bench-method proof.

sections.title: Go/no-go gates
sections.summary: Qualitative decision gates for a review meeting.

recommendations.text: Go only to deeper validation planning if target expression is coherent, activity appears antigen-dependent, controls are interpretable, off-tumor concerns have an explicit review plan, and gaps are assigned to owners.
caveats: No gate is a regulatory, biosafety, or clinical clearance.

recommendations.text: No-go or hold if activity is nonspecific, antigen-negative controls respond similarly to target-positive context, off-tumor evidence is unresolved, or the requested next step would require exact protocol design.

sections.title: Source IDs/citations
sections.summary: Appendix record that links recommendations to the curated source snapshot.

recommendations.text: Keep source records and missing-evidence labels available for expert review without letting raw IDs dominate the first-read packet.

sections.title: Caveats
sections.summary: Required boundaries for the planning artifact.

recommendations.text: Treat the packet as an expert-review input for translational scientists, not clinical advice, regulatory advice, biosafety clearance, patient guidance, or a complete executable protocol.
caveats: No patient-specific use. No expert replacement.

recommendations.text: Treat the evidence snapshot as curated and reproducible, not as a complete CLDN18.2 corpus or systematic review.

sections.title: Gap labels
sections.summary: Explicit missing-evidence labels that avoid invented specificity.

recommendations.text: Expression threshold not specified: The packet requires tumor and normal-tissue expression review, but it does not set a quantitative antigen-density threshold.
Exact model panel requires local expert selection: The packet names model-system classes, not validated cell-line or organoid panels.
Control panel must be finalized by the lab: Control categories are listed, but reagent identity, construct details, and acceptance windows remain out of scope.
Bench safety cannot be inferred from clinical context: Clinical and registry records are context-only and cannot resolve off-tumor safety for a validation program.
Evidence snapshot is curated: This packet uses a pre-reviewed source set so the exported plan stays reproducible when public APIs are unavailable.
